Hi, I'm H., HeliumDeploy's technical specialist.

I just loaded app.heliumdeploy.com from here and the site itself is responding, so it's up. That points to something local to your browser or the sign-in step.

One thing at a time:

1. Open app.heliumdeploy.com in your browser.
2. Tell me exactly what you get: a blank white page, a spinning loader, a sign-in screen that rejects you, or an error message with text.

Also tell me which phone or computer and which browser (Safari, Chrome, other). A screenshot is even better if you can send one.
Handed to the team · Cannot verify the app backend from support; "Failed to fetch" error on app.heliu

Got it, that's the error. "Failed to fetch" means the page itself loaded but it couldn't reach the backend that serves your data. Two quick things to rule out on your side:

1. Switch networks: if you're on Wi-Fi, turn it off and load it on mobile data (or the other way round), then tell me if the error changes.
2. Turn off any ad blocker, VPN or browser privacy extension for that site and reload.

If it still says "Failed to fetch" on both networks with blockers off, it's on our end, not yours.

I've passed it to JD, our hardware and systems lead, with the exact error. The team is offline now, picks it up tomorrow at 10am ET, and the answer comes to your email.

Faster route if you want it tonight: our Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf , mention @nullhashrate (JD). He and the community are active there.

Understood. So just to pin it down: did you already try it on the other network (mobile data instead of Wi-Fi, or the reverse), and still get "Failed to fetch"?

If yes, stop there, nothing more for you to do. It's our backend, and JD has it with the exact error.

One last useful detail for him if you have it: which device and browser you're on (for example iPhone / Safari, Android / Chrome, Windows / Chrome). I'll add it to the ticket.
yes i did try multiple way

That settles it then: multiple networks, same error, so it's on our side, not your setup. Nothing left for you to fix.

It's with JD with the exact error ("Failed to fetch" on app.heliumdeploy.com, reproduced on more than one network). The team is offline now, picks it up tomorrow at 10am ET, and the answer comes to your email.

If you want it looked at tonight, our Discord is the fastest: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf , mention @nullhashrate (JD).

And in the meantime, if you have a miner you need eyes on, you can still reach it locally on your own network through the Harlo OS dashboard. Happy to walk you through finding its IP if that helps.

Perfect, that's exactly what JD needs: iPhone and desktop Edge, more than one network, same "Failed to fetch". Two different devices and two different browsers failing the same way rules your end out completely. I've added that to the ticket.

So: nothing for you to try again. The team picks it up tomorrow at 10am ET and the answer comes to your email.

Tonight, if you want: Discord https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf , mention @nullhashrate (JD).

And say the word if you want to check a miner locally in the meantime, I'll walk you through getting to its dashboard on your own network.

You're welcome. Sorry it took a few rounds to land on the real cause.

You'll hear from the team by email tomorrow after 10am ET. Anything else miner-side, I'm here.
